descriptionHtml:
Fantech Stellar WHG05 Black Multi-Platform Wireless Gaming Headset (Tri-Mode Connectivity: 2.4GHz Wireless / Bluetooth 5.3 / 3.5mm Wired / 40mm Audio Drivers / Foldable Compact Design / 1 Year Official Local Agent Warranty)

Experience ultimate versatility and seamless wireless performance with the Fantech Stellar WHG05 Multi-Platform Gaming Headset in Black, available at Turbo Computer Egypt with a 1-Year Official Local Agent Warranty. Featuring Tri-Mode connectivity (2.4GHz ultra-low latency wireless dongle, Bluetooth 5.3, and 3.5mm wired mode), this headset allows effortless switching between PC, console, and mobile gaming. Powered by custom-tuned 40mm drivers, it delivers crisp highs and impactful bass, while its lightweight foldable structure and plush ear cushions guarantee all-day comfort on the go.
